templates.cargo: The underwater sound of a cargo, with a slow-speed diesel engine with a fixed-pitch propeller, heard as a deep steady drone.
templates.passenger: The underwater sound of a passenger, with medium-speed diesel propulsion, heard as a regular medium-tone rhythm.
templates.tanker: The underwater sound of a tanker, with a slow-speed diesel engine, deeply laden, heard as a heavy low-frequency rumble.
templates.tug: The underwater sound of a tug, with azimuth thrusters driven by high-rate diesels, heard as a high-rate churning thrash.
